## Downloads and independent checksum comparisons

Sources fetched directly over HTTPS on 2026-11-11:

- Stable release manifest: https://go.dev/dl/?mode=json (saved as `evidence/go-downloads.json`).
- Archives: https://go.dev/dl/go1.26.11.darwin-arm64.tar.gz and https://go.dev/dl/go1.26.11.linux-amd64.tar.gz.
- Proxy: `https://proxy.golang.org/golang.org/toolchain/@v/v0.0.1-go1.26.11.<platform>.zip`.
- Sumdb: `https://sum.golang.org/lookup/golang.org/toolchain@v0.0.1-go1.26.11.<platform>`.

The tarball and module ZIP have different bytes and raw SHA-256 values. They must not be compared for raw hash equality. The checks below authenticate each format and compare their actual file contents.

For each platform, `go mod download -json` succeeded with `GOTOOLCHAIN=local`, `GOPROXY=https://proxy.golang.org`, `GOSUMDB=sum.golang.org`, and empty `GOPRIVATE`, `GONOSUMDB`, `GONOPROXY`. The host command used the pre-existing Go 1.27.3 installation. The Go downloader verifies checksum-database records/proofs; both downloaded module records and their cached ZIP locations are saved in `evidence/proxy-<platform>.json`.

`verify-downloads.py` independently recomputes:

1. Each tarball's SHA-256 and length against go.dev's manifest.
2. Each cached proxy ZIP's raw SHA-256 and Go `dirhash.Hash1` hash against the sumdb `go.sum` line and Go downloader's `Sum` result; also the synthetic module's `go.mod` h1.
3. The Ed25519 signature on each sumdb checkpoint, using the public verification key in the pre-existing host Go source, not a newly supplied key. This signature authenticates the checkpoint; the Go downloader handles record inclusion/consistency verification.
4. Per-file SHA-256 equality between the archive and ZIP after Go's documented path/packaging transforms.

## Release notes, advisory and upstream changes

Read sources:

- https://go.dev/doc/devel/release#go1.26.11
- https://vuln.go.dev/ID/GO-2026-6859.json
- https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6859
- https://groups.google.com/g/golang-announce/c/iY8TY0wWgbM
- https://go.googlesource.com/go/+log/go1.26.10..go1.26.11
- https://go.googlesource.com/go/+/go1.26.10..go1.26.11/

Go 1.26.11 was released 2026-11-10. The advisory was published 2026-11-11 at 02:51:11 UTC. The release is **not limited to the net/http advisory**. Its announcement lists 12 security fixes: CVE-2026-97054 plus CVE-2026-97033 through CVE-2026-97043. The latter 11 harden cgo/compiler/linker/build input validation against malicious flags, pkg-config paths, symbol/library names, .syso formats, linker scripts, embedded options and quoting. These affect build tooling and are relevant to gomobile/cgo builds. Do not work around stricter checks by adding permissive `CGO_*_ALLOW` overrides; verify the actual builds in step 3.

The release history also announces assembler, compiler, runtime, bootstrapping and crypto/net fixes. The official comparison contains 27 commits and 56 changed paths, saved in `upstream-commits.txt`, `upstream-changed-files.json`, and `go1.26.11.diff`:

- 12 security commits match the 12 announced fixes. For GO-2026-6859, request-body limit state becomes atomic; connection/header decisions move to the response writer rather than mutating the header map in the body-reading goroutine.
- HTTP server body handling and EOF-draining fixes match the announced net/http bug fixes.
- Compiler changes cover rotate/shift constant types, dead-store handling of CondSelect, and generated rewrite rules; assembler changes clear the PCALIGN forward-jump list.
- Runtime reverts a 32-bit Linux timespec change. This makes the armv7 build check in the next build step especially relevant.
- Crypto changes cover FIPS approval accounting/self-tests, HKDF-Expand HMAC accounting, SHA-384 TLS accounting and RSA OAEP MGF hash checks.
- Net changes correct zero-value addresses in DialTCP/DialUDP/DialIP. Bootstrapping handles GOFIPS140 correctly; tests and version metadata accompany the fixes.

All paths fit the stated release scope; no unexplained new package, dependency manifest, maintainer change or unrelated feature was found in the comparison. The release tag is `26b4433366fce47e480679e0b5a30222b63996e0`, authored/committed by Gopher Robot and reviewed by Cherry Mui and Dmitri Shuralyov. It changes VERSION; the preceding commit is the net/http security fix. The 54 changed files retained in the module distributions also match across darwin-arm64 and linux-amd64; two top-level test files are part of the documented omissions (`cross-platform-source-check.json`). No wallet module dependency changes were made.

GO-2026-6859 / CVE-2026-97054 describes an HTTP/1 server panic when a MaxBytesReader/MaxBytesHandler request-body limit is exceeded while another goroutine writes response headers. Fixed versions are 1.26.11 and 1.27.4. Its broad symbol list includes `Client.Do`, `Client.CloseIdleConnections`, `Header.*`, `response.WriteString` and many other paths, explaining why a client app can receive a called-level report. The core's actual server exposure still needs the explicit source/call-site analysis in step 2; it is not dismissed on this reading alone.

## Checks completed in step 1

- `git diff --check`: PASS.
- Manifest SHA-256 + size checks, both platforms: PASS.
- Proxy h1 and go.mod h1 against sumdb, both platforms: PASS.
- Checkpoint signature verification against pre-existing host Go key: PASS.
- Archive/proxy file-content comparison under documented packaging rules: PASS.
- `GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.11 go version`: `go version go1.26.11 darwin/arm64` (saved as `selected-toolchain.txt`).
- `git diff --exit-code -- core/go.sum scripts/build-core.sh android/app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml`: PASS (unchanged).

A Go `toolchain` directive is a preference/minimum, so a newer installed Go can still be chosen by an unqualified `go` command. `scripts/build-core.sh:19-21` already derives and exports the exact GOTOOLCHAIN from go.mod. Later before/after checks must explicitly set `GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.10` / `GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.11`, and record `go version`, to avoid scanning under the host Go 1.27.3 by accident.

## Siblings, callers and rules checked before review

- `core/go.mod`: only active version pin found. `go 1.26.0` remains unchanged as requested.
- `scripts/build-core.sh`: one pin reader serves both release and debug gomobile builds for arm64/arm/amd64. It already forces the selected version, so it needs no edit.
